design.name: 祸斗
design.brief: The huodou (祸斗) of Chinese folklore, a black dog that eats fire and spits fire, an omen of fire disasters, hunting in packs: a lean long-legged Chinese sighthound (细犬) with real dog anatomy — deep narrow chest, tucked waist, long thin legs, long narrow muzzle, folded ears, long whip tail — about 1.6 m long and 1.1 m tall at the head. Its short coat is charred matte black like burnt wood, with a ruff of big sculpted fur clumps on the neck; jagged cracks over the ribcage on both flanks reveal a glowing molten fire belly inside (weak spot), the mouth and throat glow lava orange, small ember eyes. A frayed vermilion temple collar with a little blackened bronze bell. Hungry, fast and sly. NOT a lion, NOT a wolf, NOT a fox: a slim sighthound.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert and frost rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, golden snub-nosed monkey): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Iron, basalt and bronze as a few big faceted plates with sparse painted wear; lava and fire painted as OPAQUE glowing cracks, seams and solid sculpted flame shapes (never transparent fire, smoke or particles); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a real sighthound (quadruped): body level, the four long thin legs straight and planted, front and hind legs clearly separated with a gap of air, belly tucked up and clear of the ground; head level facing straight ahead, mouth closed, ears folded; the long thin tail hanging down and curving slightly backwards (not curled over the back); the flank cracks and the fire belly painted as opaque glowing orange (no flames sticking out, no halo, no smoke)
design.turnaround_digits: each paw with four separate clawed toes; the muzzle, ears and the whole tail fully inside the frame; in the side views the long body and tail must fit inside the view with margin.
